You are a helpful language assistant. In the video game Saints Row: The Third, players can participate in various activities that allow them to maximize property destruction before a time expires. Some of these activities were introduced in previous Saints Row games. These diversions serve the plot and are positioned as training the player-character or damaging the Syndicate. They can also be repeated. Outside of structured diversions, players can explore the game's open world and engage in various activities and missions.

In addition to the video game, "Maximum Mayhem" is also the title of two occasional poems published as broadsides and signed "M.M.", though the source texts have been lost.
